dialogues.speaker: Pumayna
dialogues.text: Huha Hill costs 20,000 Mora per person per night, including the entertainment facilities at Wavey Bay, Colorfall Cliffs, and Villa Guiztli. But this doesn't cover additional expenses.

dialogues.speaker: Pumayna
dialogues.text: So for our family of five, that's 100,000 Mora per day. And this is already their cheapest offer during the trial period...

dialogues.speaker: Pumayna
dialogues.text: If we're conservative about what we eat — and we skip on the souvenirs... a budget of 500,000 Mora should cover us for four days.

dialogues.speaker: Pumayna
dialogues.text: But it looks like Q'ellu really wants an Asha souvenir, and I think Ca'asho wants to try the drinks at that Me & Dew bar...

dialogues.speaker: Pumayna
dialogues.text: ...Y'know what, better not to be penny-wise, pound-foolish. As long as the family has fun, the worst that can happen is that I'll have to work some overtime when I get back.
